time_rule: time_s = start_frame / 24 (start_frame differs from frame for end- or hit-anchored files)
gain_rule: gain_db is applied to the file as-is (files are the other agents' -14 LUFS / normalised masters); then the whole sum goes through the master chain below (measured.master_makeup_db is that chain's static make-up; add it to every gain for a no-master-bus rebuild in the edit)

automation.vo_duck: sidechain from the VO (50 ms look-ahead, 40 ms attack / 260 ms release, thr -42 dBFS, 12 dB range): music -3 dB, SFX beds by vo_duck_db (room drone 3, server hum 4, typing 6); it releases inside the semicolon pause so the D-flat colour note speaks
automation.chant_duck: music -4 dB while the whisper sounds, f282-300 only
automation.end_fade: whole mix squared fade f706 -> f719.5 so the loop starts and ends in silence (as the theme)

master: glue compressor (thr -15 dBFS, 1.5:1, 30/250 ms, 90 Hz sidechain HPF) + make-up + 4x-oversampled look-ahead true-peak limiter (1.5 ms, 90 ms release), iterated to -14.0 LUFS-I, ceiling -1.0 dBTP
